# river docs

docs for the river project

hosted on railway

## getting started

```bash
bun i
```

```bash
bun dev
```

# river redis provider

allows for resumable streams with redis

{
	"name": "@davis7dotsh/river",
	"private": true,
	"scripts": {
		"dev": "turbo run dev",
		"lint": "turbo run lint",
		"format": "prettier --write \"**/*.{ts,tsx,md}\"",
		"clean": "find . -type d \\( -name \"node_modules\" -o -name \"dist\" -o -name \"build\" -o -name \".turbo\" -o -name \".svelte-kit\" \\) -prune -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true",
		"check-types": "turbo run check-types",
		"start:sandbox": "turbo run --filter=@davis7dotsh/river-sandbox start",
		"build:all": "turbo run build",
		"build:sandbox": "turbo run --filter=@davis7dotsh/river-sandbox build",
		"build:redis": "turbo run --filter=@davis7dotsh/river-provider-redis build",
		"build:core": "turbo run --filter=@davis7dotsh/river-core build",
		"build:svelte": "turbo run --filter=@davis7dotsh/river-adapter-sveltekit build",
		"build:docs": "turbo run --filter=@davis7dotsh/river-docs build",
		"start:docs": "turbo run --filter=@davis7dotsh/river-docs start",
		"deploy:docs": "turbo run --filter=@davis7dotsh/river-docs deploy",
		"publish:all": "turbo run publish",
		"publish:redis": "turbo run --filter=@davis7dotsh/river-provider-redis publish",
		"publish:core": "turbo run --filter=@davis7dotsh/river-core publish",
		"publish:svelte": "turbo run --filter=@davis7dotsh/river-adapter-sveltekit publish",
		"publish:tanstack": "turbo run --filter=@davis7dotsh/river-adapter-tanstack publish"
	},
	"devDependencies": {
		"prettier": "^3.6.2",
		"turbo": "^2.6.0",
		"typescript": "^5.9.3"
	},
	"engines": {
		"node": ">=22"
	},
	"packageManager": "bun@1.3.1",
	"workspaces": [
		"apps/*",
		"packages/*"
	]
}

{
	"name": "@davis7dotsh/river-adapter-sveltekit",
	"version": "0.2.0",
	"description": "sveltekit adapter for river",
	"keywords": [
		"river",
		"sveltekit",
		"svelte",
		"streaming",
		"ai"
	],
	"publishConfig": {
		"access": "public"
	},
	"author": "Ben Davis (https://davis7.sh)",
	"license": "MIT",
	"repository": {
		"type": "git",
		"url": "https://github.com/bmdavis419/river",
		"directory": "packages/adapter-sveltekit"
	},
	"scripts": {
		"dev": " nodemon --watch src --ext ts,svelte,css,html,json --exec 'bun run build'",
		"build": "bunx --bun vite build && npm run prepack",
		"prepare": "svelte-kit sync || echo ''",
		"prepack": "svelte-kit sync && svelte-package && publint",
		"publish": "npm publish",
		"check": "svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json",
		"check:watch": "svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --watch",
		"format": "prettier --write .",
		"lint": "prettier --check ."
	},
	"files": [
		"dist",
		"!dist/**/*.test.*",
		"!dist/**/*.spec.*"
	],
	"sideEffects": [
		"**/*.css"
	],
	"svelte": "./dist/index.js",
	"types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
	"type": "module",
	"exports": {
		".": {
			"types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
			"svelte": "./dist/index.js"
		}
	},
	"peerDependencies": {
		"svelte": "^5.0.0",
		"@davis7dotsh/river-core": "*",
		"neverthrow": "^8.2.0"
	},
	"devDependencies": {
		"@sveltejs/kit": "^2.47.1",
		"svelte-adapter-bun": "^1.0.1",
		"@sveltejs/package": "^2.5.4",
		"@sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte": "^6.2.1",
		"nodemon": "^3.1.10",
		"prettier": "^3.6.2",
		"prettier-plugin-svelte": "^3.4.0",
		"publint": "^0.3.14",
		"svelte": "^5.41.0",
		"svelte-check": "^4.3.3",
		"typescript": "^5.9.3",
		"vite": "^7.1.10"
	}
}
